The included verifier exhaustively checks every word through n=6, an independently coded literal-allocation recurrence through n=12, and the original table through n=8, plus reported rows through n=20; it ends VERIFY_OK. Finite checks support rather than replace the infinite combinatorial bijection.

value.rationale: The 2022 source poses the count by the number of runs as a specific enumerative gap. This finite, positive-coefficient recurrence answers it for the full unrestricted flattened parking-function family at every length, gives distinct specified-run coefficients instead of only an unrefined total or narrow insertion subclass, and is replayable without enumerating all words. A fixed-order scalar recurrence or closed OGF is neither needed for this natural answer nor claimed.
